newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah firm in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah firm in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was firm against the dollar in slow late trading on Thursday on liquidity worries due to month-end factors, dealers said.
They said the market remained slow as many overseas operators were seen staying on the sidelines due to the Thanksgiving public holiday in the United States.
"I don't see anything much happening today. Many overseas operators prefer to stay sidelined," one Japanese bank dealer said.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,343.25/44.00 in late trading against an opening of 2,344.25/45.25.
Another bank dealer said rupiah supply was relatively adequate, but worries of a possible tightening of liquidity due to month-end factors kept sentiment on the rupiah firm.
Tommorow rupiah was at 2,341.30/2,341.70. There was no trade in value today due to the Thanksgiving holiday in the United States.
Another bank dealer said the dollar-rupiah rate was expected to range between 2,343.50 and 2,344.50 on Friday.
One-month swap was at 15.00/16.00, two at 31.00/32.00, three at 44.00/45.00 and six at 88.50/89.00 points.
The central bank increased its intervention rate by one point to 2,343/2,535 and the conversion rate also by one point to 2,343/2,391 late on Thursday.
